other_text: FOR TWO YEARS YOU'VE BEEN SAYING "Give us another like 'The Valley of the Moon'!" Well show it!" All right! Here it is! Reid's best picture in two years. The Valley of the Moon was a masterpiece of acting and setting. This one shows it qualities that make a picture straight stuff. Well show it-and count your receipts! Great. The Hell Diggers GOES the past success one by one.
